verdict.rationale: The evidence documents only per-session operations: creating a single verification session, polling a single decision, and manually reviewing sessions in the Customer Portal. The one batch mention is service-quality batch upload testing that must be arranged with the onboarding team and is "very use case specific." That is an adjacent, vendor-arranged test process, not a documented bulk-operations capability users can invoke across many items.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
